decision: No packaging or application-gate blocker introduced by the narrow pytest discovery configuration.
scope: Independent source/evidence read only; no code changes, new archive install, model calls or additional suite run.
findings: Automatic pytest discovery now begins in the maintained tests/ tree. All maintained unit/API/QA/harness regression modules remain available. No per-test exclusion, marker filter or assertion change was introduced.

New docs/test_*.py historical snapshots retain old import roots and experiment-specific audit hooks. Treating those evidence copies as ordinary application test modules caused the initial discovery errors; their bytes and the failed run are preserved.
Frozen standalone experiment commands and maintained tests that explicitly read/reconstruct historical contracts remain usable. A scoped discovery root does not delete or rewrite those records.

The candidate workflow creates the complete committed source tree with git archive. There is no application-file allowlist excluding pytest.ini; once committed it is included automatically. This review does not claim a not-yet-built archive was installed.

The launchers use installation/runtime entry points rather than pytest discovery, so pytest.ini does not alter launcher behavior or application requirements. Existing member-count, byte-cap, archive provenance/path/symlink and required asr_timing.py gates remain unchanged.

Root reran the ordinary complete command after the discovery correction. The retained maintained-suite log reports834 tests and54 subtests passed in11.55 seconds, separately from the initial failed collection.
